description: Resumes an existing run in place (ADR-014), reusing its run_id and its raw_games cache rather than starting a new run and re-fetching the whole catalog.
signature: def resume_run(db_path: Path, run_id: str, *, settings: Settings | None = None) -> str
docstring:
Resume an existing, non-running run from its first non-succeeded stage.

Args:
    db_path: Never a connection, same reasoning as start_pipeline_async.
    run_id: An existing run. Must not currently be registered as running (is_running(run_id) is False) and must not already have all three stages succeeded.
    settings: Loaded via config.load_settings() if not given.

Returns:
    run_id, unchanged -- no new run row, no new id, parent_run_id is never written.

Raises:
    PipelineError: If run_id is unknown, is currently registered as running, or has all three run_stages rows already 'succeeded'.

Sequence:
    1. with storage.connect(db_path) as conn: run = storage.get_run(conn, run_id); raise PipelineError if None. If is_running(run_id): raise PipelineError. stages = storage.read_run_stages(conn, run_id); succeeded = {s.stage for s in stages if s.status == 'succeeded'}; if succeeded == {'acquisition','enrichment','analysis'}: raise PipelineError (all done, a new run is the right action instead). start_stage = the first PipelineStage, in pipeline order, not in succeeded. resumed_config = PipelineConfig.from_dict(run.config) with start_stage replaced by the computed value.
    2. From here, identical to start_pipeline_async's steps 4-6 (register cancellation, start worker, return run_id), EXCEPT no storage.create_run call -- the existing run row is reused, and its status is set to 'running' by the worker's first begin_run_stage call, not by resume_run itself.
    3. The ADR-013 consistency check still runs inside the worker's run_pipeline call, even though this is a resume -- a resume against a hand-edited parameters.toml must still be caught, not silently allowed to continue with stale-vs-current parameters mismatched.
preconditions: Not all three run_stages rows for run_id are 'succeeded'
postconditions: The returned run_id equals the input run_id exactly
runs.parent_run_id for this run_id is unchanged (still whatever it was before, typically NULL)
No new row is added to runs by this call
The worker resumes from the first stage, in pipeline order, that is not 'succeeded' -- a stage that never started and a stage that started-then-failed are both eligible resume points

edge_cases.expected_behavior: PipelineError -- 'the user wants a new run, which is a different action' (module spec's own wording)

edge_cases.input: run_id currently has a live worker (another tab already resumed it)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: PipelineError, no second worker started -- prevents the two-workers-for-one-run_id case the module spec calls 'impossible by construction'

edge_cases.input: No stage has ever been attempted (crashed during preflight originally, so run_stages is empty)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: resumes from acquisition -- the normal path after a crash before any stage began

edge_cases.input: acquisition succeeded, enrichment failed, analysis never attempted
parameters.toml changed since the original run
edge_cases.expected_behavior: not blocked here -- the ADR-013 check inside the resumed run_pipeline call is what validates this; if it still passes (parameters.toml still matches FORMULATION.md, just different locked values than the original run used), the resumed stages are stamped with the CURRENT parameters_version, and a warning run_event is appended noting the run now spans two parameters_version values across its rows

unit_tests.name: test_resume_picks_first_non_succeeded_stage
unit_tests.description: Table-driven over all meaningful combinations of the three stages' statuses (none attempted; acquisition succeeded only; acquisition+enrichment succeeded; acquisition succeeded+enrichment failed), asserting the correct start_stage each time.

unit_tests.name: test_resume_all_succeeded_raises
unit_tests.description: A run with all three stages succeeded raises PipelineError.

unit_tests.name: test_resume_already_running_raises
unit_tests.description: Calling resume_run while is_running(run_id) is True raises PipelineError and starts no second worker.

unit_tests.name: test_resume_unknown_run_id_raises
unit_tests.description: resume_run for a nonexistent run_id raises PipelineError.

unit_tests.name: test_resume_returns_same_run_id_no_new_row
unit_tests.description: resume_run's return value equals the input run_id, and storage.list_runs shows no additional row.
unit_tests.expected: returned run_id == input; run count unchanged

unit_tests.name: test_resume_makes_no_further_http_call_for_already_fetched_appids
unit_tests.description: Integration: a run failed mid-acquisition, then resumed, fetches only the appids missing from raw_games for that run_id (asserted against a recording HTTP stub).
unit_tests.expected: HTTP calls only for previously-unfetched appids
